rules.title: Writ literal value forms
rules.statement: A Writ literal value is one of: null, a boolean, an integer, a negative integer, a float, a string, a map, an array, a type literal, or a config slot-type. Each form has a distinct node code (WRIT_NULL, WRIT_BOOL, WRIT_INT, WRIT_NEG_INT, WRIT_FLOAT, WRIT_STR, WRIT_MAP, WRIT_ARRAY, WRIT_TYPE_LIT, CFG_SLOT_TYPE).

rules.title: Writ null literal
rules.statement: A missing/null Writ value and the WRIT_NULL form both denote the literal `null`.

rules.title: Writ boolean literal
rules.statement: A WRIT_BOOL value renders as `true` iff its VALUE is a non-null scalar whose byte is nonzero, else `false`; an absent or zero VALUE is `false`.

rules.title: Writ integer and float literals
rules.statement: WRIT_INT and WRIT_FLOAT carry their VALUE as the verbatim source token text. A WRIT_NEG_INT renders as `-` prefixed to its VALUE token text (sign is a separate node form, not part of the magnitude token).

rules.title: Writ string literal retains quotes
rules.statement: A WRIT_STR's VALUE is the STRING token captured WITH its surrounding quotes; the quoted text is the literal verbatim (no separate unquoting/requoting step).

rules.title: Writ config slot-type path
rules.statement: A CFG_SLOT_TYPE denotes a type referenced by a dotted path: a head NAME followed by zero or more `.`-separated step NAMEs, rendered `<type: name.step1.step2…>`.

rules.title: Writ array value rendering
rules.statement: A WRIT_ARRAY value renders as `[` <items> `]` where items are comma-separated rendered Writ values; an empty array renders as `[]`.

rules.title: Writ map value rendering
rules.statement: A WRIT_MAP value renders as `{` <entries> `}` where entries are comma-separated. Each entry (WRIT_ENTRY) renders as `KEY: VALUE`; an entry carrying no VALUE renders as just `KEY: ` (key with empty value). An empty map renders as `{}`.
